title: Crumple
description: A real film photo print, Kodak's sun hats on a wall, lying on the table, animated like stop-motion at 8 frames a second. Each press crushes it one step further: the first squeeze breaks it into sharp creases and flat facets, each later one folds it tighter until it is a faceted ball under the lamp. Keep pressing and it opens back out a step at a time, keeping every crease.
intent: Realistic paper in discrete stages, shown at a stepped stop-motion frame rate: the crease simulation is baked offline, a spring carries each press to the next stage every display frame so input stays immediate, and the picture only advances every 125ms, settle included.
sources: Print photo: kodim03 (hats), a 35mm film scan from Kodak Photo CD PCD0992, released by the Eastman Kodak Company for unrestricted usage; via https://github.com/MohamedBakrAli/Kodak-Lossless-True-Color-Image-Suite (mirror of http://r0k.us/graphics/kodak/), cropped square and re-encoded as webp.
